request.subject: PORTRAIT:CULT:GUARD

layers.text: Style: bold chibi pixel art for a playful turn-based strategy board game, a board game come to life: chunky simple shapes, flat colours with one shadow tone, low detail, clean readable silhouette that reads at a glance at small size, slightly silly and cheerful.
layers.negative: photorealism, painterly brushwork, gradients, dithering, noise, tiny details, thin outline, low-poly 3D, faceted polygons, blur, text, letters, numbers, logo, UI, frame, health bar, selection ring, cropped subject

layers.text: Camera: head-and-shoulders bust portrait for a game interface, level three-quarter view, the character turned slightly to the right (south-east) and looking at the viewer, head and upper chest filling most of the square, centred on a transparent background. The bust ends cleanly at the chest; nothing else is in the image.

Faction: a pulp-magazine secret society of the 1920s, sinister, grim and evil, not cute. Their colours: ceremonial cloth of deep blood red and black, embroidered with tarnished gold occult sigils; dull brass; pale cream candle wax and parchment; bright red fresh blood on blades; and one small accent, a glowing spring green, only as candle flames and sparks.
layers.negative: cute, friendly smile, tentacles, tentacle hands, skull face, skull mask, skeleton, glowing eyes, empty black face, monster face, teal, cyan, blue cloth, indigo cloth, gore, guts, slime, magenta, pink, orange flames, yellow flames, blue flames, steel armour, chrome, gold armour, sword, gun, staff, pentagram, cross, large glowing area

layers.text: Class: one chunky cute character portrait with a huge round head and big friendly eyes, the same chunky body language as the map piece, thick single-colour black outline, big simple shapes and flat colours with one shadow tone; it must read at a glance at 48 pixels.
layers.negative: full body, legs, feet, standing figure, pedestal, base, plinth, frame, border, circle background, badge, medallion, vignette, background scenery, second character, crowd, text

layers.text: Subject: Idol Bearer portrait, head and shoulders of a chunky stout bald man of an evil secret society with a heavy grim scowl and grey stubble, black robe shoulders with a blood-red and gold stole, and resting on top of his bald head, held by his two hands, a squat pale grey stone idol head with a wide evil toothy grin and two small green eyes; simple shapes and very few details.

A close-up bust: the head and shoulders fill the whole square; no legs. The man is bald and clean-shaven with a heavy scowl. The idol on his head is carved dull grey stone, a stone god's face with a broad flat nose, thick lips and a wide grin of square teeth, clearly carved stone and never a skull.
layers.negative: full body, legs, feet, skull, skull face, skeleton, beard, tentacles, glowing eyes, empty hood, blue robe
